prompts.name: fighter
prompts.prompt: Create one production game VFX component atlas, square 1024x1024, transparent RGBA background, exactly 2 columns and 2 rows of equally sized cells. Each cell contains ONE isolated original magical effect centered inside a 440x440 area, with 36px transparent padding on all sides, no overlap across cell boundaries. NO text, NO labels, NO frames, NO characters, NO scenery. Refined high-end 2D pixel art for a top-down fantasy RPG, clearly visible stepped pixels, controlled 3-to-5 shade ramps, finely detailed sharp silhouettes, no fuzzy bloom, no blur, no gradient fog. This is a STATIC four-part asset atlas whose parts will be animated in an engine, not a mockup. Keep empty interior areas truly transparent and shapes legible over grass. Crimson, silver-white and dark garnet martial sword energy, NOT fire magic. Top-left: large elegant silver razor crescent slash, curving from lower left to upper right, layered crimson afterimages at its outer edge, sharp tapering tips. Top-right: horizontal needle-thin white sword-energy beam across the middle, red ink-brush splinters and angular steel glints, width about 410 height100. Bottom-left: beautifully detailed converging circular sword-qi seal with six thin spear-like sword streaks pointing inward, center empty. Bottom-right: explosive angular impact star made of crossing silver blade cuts, dark-red torn fissures and tiny sharp sparks, center brilliant ivory. Original wuxia master atmosphere, lavish but disciplined.
